# general commands

Every `general` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `ai`

Start an interactive AI assistant backed by a local LLM. Uses skills defined with #[AsAiSkill].

```bash
bin/semitexa ai
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--yes` | no |

## `completion`

Dump the shell completion script

```bash
bin/semitexa completion [shell]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--debug` | no |

## `help`

Display help for a command

```bash
bin/semitexa help [command_name]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--format` | yes |
| `--raw` | no |

## `init`

Create or sync Semitexa project scaffold from semitexa/ultimate

```bash
bin/semitexa init
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | yes |
| `--force` | no |
| `--only-docs` | no |

## `install`

Handled by the `bin/semitexa` wrapper before PHP starts.

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--raw` | no |
| `--format` | yes |
| `--short` | no |

## `make`

Recipe-driven scaffold dispatcher — runs a recipe's generator_chain end-to-end

```bash
bin/semitexa make
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--recipe` | yes |
| `--arg` | yes |
| `--write` | no |
| `--force` | no |
| `--override-duplicate` | no |
| `--json` | no |
| `--ndjson` | no |
| `--trace` | yes |

## `update`

```bash

```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--allow-destructive` | no |
| `--write-scaffold-candidates` | no |
| `--no-composer` | no |
| `--composer-only` | no |
| `--allow-partial-composer-update` | no |
